CHAPTER.VERS: But he gives more grace. Therefore [the Scripture] says, God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.

Don't speak one against another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother, or judges his brother, speaks against the law, and judges the law: but if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.
There is [only] one lawgiver and judge, the one who is able to save and to destroy: but who are you that judge your fellow man?
To him therefore that knows to do good, and doesn't do it, to him it is sin.
